Superstore

From Helldivers Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search
Stores
Acquisition
Superstore

The Superstore is an item shop in Helldivers 2 accessible through the Acquisition Center. In it Armor sets, Weapons, and Cosmetics based on various Warbonds plus an extra War Horses set can be bought using Super Credits. Superstore items are exclusive to the store and are unobtainable through the warbonds themselves.

Release Order

New pages are periodically added, generally but not always to the Rotating catalog:

  1. SC-37 Legionnaire & SC-15 Drone Master became available on February 08, 2024.
  2. B-24 Enforcer & CE-74 Breaker became available on February 10, 2024.
  3. B-27 Fortified Commando & FS-38 Eradicator became available on February 12, 2024.
  4. B-08 Light Gunner & FS-61 Dreadnought became available on February 14, 2024.
  5. FS-11 Executioner & CM-21 Trench Paramedic became available on February 16, 2024.
  6. CE-81 Juggernaut & FS-34 Exterminator became available on February 18, 2024.
  7. CM-17 Butcher & CE-67 Titan became available on March 14, 2024.
  8. CM-10 Clinician & FS-37 Ravager became available on April 16, 2024.
  9. CW-9 White Wolf & CE-64 Grenadier became available on May 10, 2024.
  10. PH-56 Jaguar & CE-101 Guerilla Gorilla became available on June 13, 2024.
  11. I-44 Salamander & I-92 Fire Fighter became available on August 8, 2024.
  12. AF-52 Lockdown & AF-91 Field Chemist became available on September 19, 2024.
  13. UF-84 Doubt Killer & Cover of Darkness became available on October 31, 2024.
  14. SR-64 Cinderblock, Stone-Wrought Perseverance & Stun Baton became available on December 13, 2024.
  15. StA-52 Assault Rifle, AC-1 Dutiful, Strength in Our Arms & Assault Infantry became available on December 18, 2024 in collaboration with Killzone 2.[1]
  16. CQC-5 Combat Hatchet, IE-57 Hell-Bent & Vision of Freedom became available on February 6, 2025.
  17. GS-11 Democracy's Deputy, Veil of the Valorous Vagabond & Draw! became available on March 20, 2025.
  18. RE-824 Bearer of the Standard & Seal of General Consensus became available on May 15, 2025.
  19. BP-77 Grand Juror, Badge of Order & P-92 Warrant became available on June 12, 2025.
  20. AD-11 Livewire, Schema Laid Bare & Enthusiastic Mirth became available on July 17, 2025.
  21. DS-10 Big Game Hunter, Eternal Corona & CQC-42 Machete became available on September 4, 2025.
  22. RS-6 Fiend Destroyer, De-Forester's Sailcloth & DBS-2 Double Freedom became available on December 2, 2025.
  23. RS-100 Sanctioner, Gilded Quill & G-89 Smokescreen became available on January 22, 2026.
  24. DP-8 Mountain-Scaled & Thundering Hooves of Loyalty became available on February 10, 2026.
  25. CPR-80 Bulwark, Testament to Attrition & SG-97 Sweeper became available on March 17, 2026.

Reviews

Our review tracking was managed by users and has not been updated in some time.

“Reviews” are visible at the bottom of the Superstore. Switching between items also updates the displayed reviews.
Potential reviews include, but are not limited to:

  • “It will feel like you're out there, fighting beside them from your home!” - HelldiVR_88
  • “Amazing quality. It even survived atmospheric re-entry... twice!” - Winganon_59
  • “So easy to use even my grandma loves it” - Knittingiscool11
  • “The glory of Super Earth is mirrored in it's production value!” - Real_NovaStarz
  • “Excellent quality! Resistant even against the most gross bug goo.” - TLdyHero
  • “Amazing quality, I bought one for me and TWO for my kid. She loves them.” - PapaPatrioot
  • “Great for camping trips with the kids! A bit heavy for them though.” - FamilyMan123
  • “My wife said it's this or her. She will be missed.” - Bronko_P4triot
  • “I'm [redacted] and this is my favorite product in the acquisition center!” - Specctrei
  • “Perfect for a true patriot of Super Earth!” - Patriot_251
  • “Mine arrived with some real sweat of heroes still inside it!” - x_Roocketman_x
  • “My only complaint is that I wish I had another one” - LtBadazz500
  • “Good for stealth. Bad for enemy.” - Okane_82
  • “I've used this every day for the past few weeks!” - Karen0057
  • “This is the best thing I've ever seen in my life! Can not live without!” - PixiePyxie555
  • “Recommended by 9 out of 10 dentists” - DrSpindleshanks
  • “Very authentic and easy to put on. I am very satisfied!” - mike__the_spike
  • “You can tell by just touching it, that this was made for real heroes.” - Strive_to_Dive_16
  • “Love this item, shipping A+++++++. Would purchase again. Highly recommended!!!!” - B1qBeefEater
  • “Freedom isn't free, but this lets you dispense it with glee!” - MilitaryBeefHunk99
  • “RepeatCustomer: Nice improvement on the previous identical model” - Golf_Dad22
  • “Quality is out of this world! Sometimes I put it on just to wear around the house.” - M0o0ns22
  • “The best thing I've bought since my Combat Knife!” - WarwLzard66
  • “I already own one but I bought it again to support our heroes out there!” - StarfQtr_97
  • “I bought this for my husband and he loves it.” - SuperCitizen_2
  • “Review under investigation for treason” - [Redacted]

Beneath the reviews, a disclaimer states: “All of these reviews have been devised by Super Earth's Ministry of Truth after an analysis to reflect the most accurate possible opinions of loyal Super Earth citizenry. In other words, these are not real reviews.”

Trivia

Purchased primary weapons (DBS-2 Double Freedom and SG-97 Sweeper) in Superstore show currently selected Pattern for that weapon.

Change History

Patch
Description

1.006.202
2026-04-28
(Mid-Patch)

Rotating pages feature removed, all content sets now have permanent pages.

1.003.000
2025-05-15
(Mid-Patch)

New content added alongside Masters of Ceremony Premium Warbond. The Superstore will have one rotating page featuring six different content sets that changes every 48 hours, shortening the rotation to 12 days. All the earlier Superstore items from older Warbonds are available to purchase anytime. When new Warbonds are released, one of the current rotating sets will be moved to a permanent page.

1.002.200
2025-03-20
(Mid-Patch)

New content added alongside Borderline Justice Premium Warbond, pages and rotations re-ordered.

1.002.105
2025-02-18

Pages re-enabled.

1.002.101
2025-02-06
(Mid-Patch)

  • The rotation changed:
    • From chronological to reverse chronological order.
  • Pages added.
    • Pages disabled, a visual bug had the potential to cause unintended player purchases.

1.002.003
2024-12-28
(Mid-Patch)

The rotation changed:

  1. from a mixed pattern—beginning with the latest entries through the seventh, then progressing chronologically through the sixth and resetting with each new release.
  2. to a fully chronological order.

References

  1. ↑ Phase 1 Killzone items are not available in the Superstore since December 2024. You can now find these items inside of the Righteous Revenants Legendary Warbond.
